Test copy: what the first browser version shows

Slice 1 builds a copy that runs in Chrome with nothing installed. It reads the part and shows the 3D model. It runs no checks yet, so every step says so plainly. Below is the real app with these changes, on report_sample.step.

Reply in chat: Approve, Change (say what), or Rethink. No code is written until you approve.

The screens

Tap a picture to zoom.

What I chose beyond the spec’s list

The spec names the header, the start-form line, the hidden .ipt field and the two “not yet” lines. Making them showed these too:

  • The line under the form. Today it reads “Your files are analyzed on this computer and deleted straight after. Nothing is kept.” In this copy the file is never sent anywhere, so the spec’s wording replaces it: “Your file stays on this computer. Nothing is uploaded.”
  • Features card and Features step. Today, with no findings, both say “No findings. Every feature checked passed its rules.” With no check run, that would be false. So the line takes its place, and the chips (Issues 0 · Passed 0) and Show OK switches hide. From S2 they come back, counting holes only.
  • Report step. The “Checks run” list would be empty, so it hides. “The PDF holds” keeps only page 1 and the assumptions; the plan, finding pages and .ipt lines come back with their slices.
  • The PDF. Page 1 prints the same line after the part summary. Not pictured: the PDF can’t show it until the line is built.
  • Status line. Today it says “Choose a STEP file to start. Add its .ipt too, if you have one.” With the .ipt field hidden it becomes “Choose a STEP file to start.”
  • Turning. The list follows the process. For a turned part it reads: “Not checked yet in this copy: Hole depth check, Hole size check, Thin wall check, Turning axis check, Length to diameter check, Bore depth check, .ipt check.”
  • .ipt check in the list. It stays in “Not checked yet” although this copy has no .ipt field yet, so the list is complete.
  • First open. The engine is about 11.5 MB to download the first time (cached after). Meanwhile the page shows “Analyzing …” as in picture 2, and the 60 s time limit starts only once the engine has loaded. I suggest no new wording for this wait; say if you want one.
  • “Test copy” mark. Boxed, in the header after the name, in the normal type (not the capitals the Fix / Review labels use).
  • The line’s look. Ink text on the page grey, with a grey bar on the left. It uses no severity color, so it can’t be mistaken for a finding.
  • “Licenses”, American spelling. The spec wrote “Licences”; the style rule is American spelling, so the link and page say “Licenses”. The page lists the engine (exact package, its source and license text), the other packages and the fonts.

What stays the same

  • Every other word and message that exists today: the part summary, the step bar, and every refusal (not a STEP file, no solid, too large, took too long, failed, each with Try again where it is today).
  • The look: the same colors, fonts and sizes.
